items.title: Watch the priority rule from L3's fix decide the actual total
items.description: Uses this unit's own `calculateDiscount` logic: loyalty (85% of total, at quantity 3+) is checked before bulk (90% of total, at quantity 5+). Toggle the loyalty flag and drag quantity across the threshold at 5 to see exactly where the priority between the two rules — now explicit, not accidental — determines the total.
items.compute: const total = params.price * params.quantity; const isLoyalty = params.loyaltyFlag >= 1; let rate = 1; if (isLoyalty && params.quantity >= 3) { rate = 0.85; } else if (params.quantity >= 5) { rate = 0.9; } const discountedTotal = Math.round(total * rate * 100) / 100; return { discountedTotal };
